_about: One name per thing across HomePowerRebate. scripts/check_consistency.py checks every page against this file and fails when a rule's count goes above _partials/consistency-baseline.json. Add a rule here when you find a new inconsistency; fix pages through their generator or a post-step normalizer (fix_redirected_links.py), never by hand.

cta_labels._about: Button-like links (class btn/cta/button, or text ending in an arrow) to these pages must use one of these labels. Prose links inside a sentence are not checked here.

terms.why: The finder is not an assessment; in Ontario and Massachusetts 'assessment' means a real home energy audit.
The finder does not send quote requests; installer ranking forms do ('Request my quotes').
The finder estimates; only the program confirms the exact amount.
Retired model: we rank by Google reviews, we do not vet.
The finder asks for a city, not an address.
We do not ask for energy bills (owner, 2026-10-14).

terms.pattern: \b(?:we'll|we will) connect you with an installer\b|\bmatch(?:es)? you with (?:a single|one|installers who)\b|\bget matched with\b
terms.use: show you the top-rated installers; you choose who to call
terms.why: We list top-rated installers; we do not assign one (locked decision).

headings._about: One h1 per page; no jump from h2 to h4 inside main unless the h4 carries aria-level="3".
